answer: Pairwise-bounded quadratic-funding matching defangs sybils by capping the subsidy shared between any two agents that always co-fund together. A lone honest contributor stands out like a single bloom in an open meadow, but a flock of clones signing under one reused cipher behaves as tightly correlated pairs, so the match algorithm bounds their joint payout and the marginal delta each extra alias adds collapses toward zero. Splitting one treasury across a hundred identities no longer multiplies the match, erasing the economic reason to farm fakes.
